integrity: Mathematical proof and finite diagnostic script are provided. All universal claims rely on analytic arguments, not finite computation. Earlier frameworks and possible overlaps are cited; no external independent validation or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The construction varies alphabet and Bernoulli baseline with q; local exact pair of equilibria for beta>1 is claimed only sufficiently close to one. Sharp alphabet bound is restricted to symmetric Gaussian-moment-matching laws. Low-q cases and Gaussian quadrature/duality tools predate this result; complete older general-spin coverage was not accessible.
title: Optimal-alphabet multicritical transitions from Gaussian quadrature
